michelle: heads up — noticed Cost Explorer p95 jumps to ~6–8s when expanding the per-token breakdown for larger tenants :eyes:

omar: ouch. is that the UI making a single heavy query or a lot of small ones?

michelle: single heavy aggregation. group by tenant_id, model_sku, token_fingerprint. planner shows hash aggregation on a massive set.

sree: we've seen this before. high-cardinality dims wreck the OLAP path. sampling at ingest helped for general cost but broke cache-savings accuracy.

jon: Proposal: two-query surface — interactive UI reads pre-aggregated rollups (1h buckets + bucketed-fingerprint), and an "exact" export that runs an expensive raw scan (async). UI should label approximate results.

laura: UX: please add a clear badge: "approximate (±X%) — uses sampled rollups" and a CTA: "Run exact (may take minutes)". Users need to trust numbers for billing. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

michelle: repro query (simplified):
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, model_sku, fingerprint, SUM(tokens) AS tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-07'
GROUP BY tenant_id, model_sku, fingerprint
```
That GROUP BY fingerprint is the perf killer.

omar: idea — compute fingerprint_bucket = farm32(fingerprint) % 100 at write time and maintain rollups by fingerprint_bucket instead of fingerprint for UI. keeps cardinality bounded to ~100 * tenants * skus.

sree: that reduces cardinality but biases cache-savings when collisions happen. We can estimate collision error empirically. Also needs re-ingestion for historical correctness.

jon: alternate: keep hot raw traces for last-7d for exact queries; older data served from rollups. For long-tail invoices, run background exact joins to a BigQuery-like export and notify when ready.

deploy_bot: rolled out a staging change: dashboard-query-timeout fallback set to 30s. If query >30s UI auto-switches to rollup/approx view. (deployment id: deploy-2026-03-17-39)

laura: Also show a latency hint in the UI when toggling dimensions: "This breakdown may be slow due to high-cardinality — try 1h rollups or toggle 'approximate'" :warning:

michelle: action items:
- omar: spike prototype for fingerprint_bucket write transform + storage schema (PR?)
- sree: quantify sampling vs exact for cache-savings across 1k tenants (report numbers)
- jon: implement async exact export + notification flow + UI CTA
- laura: mockup approximate badge and latency hint copy

omar: I'll sketch a storage sketch tonight and link the repo.

sree: I'll run A/B and post error bars, also test hyperloglog for distinct counts (might help some metrics).

jon: agree on hybrid approach. we'll discuss tradeoffs on Wed sync.

michelle: thanks — please drop short updates here.

laura: cc @michelle @omar @sree — design + eng check-in Wed 10am PT. :calendar:
